saw_lines: Nobody buys a sofa without knowing when it arrives and whether it fits the stairs.
So the delivery answer belongs in the first line, since a shopper who sees no date clicks away and buys elsewhere.
Your ads say nothing on shipping, 0 of 30 ads, while your site answers it. Lead three new ads with the delivery window and the 30 day home test.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 2 Nov 2026
points: 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery though your site answers it. A shopper who cannot see a delivery window scrolls past and buys elsewhere. Open three new ads with the delivery window and the 30 day home test.
0 of 24 ads carry a proof number, so a buyer who cannot touch the sofa has nothing firm to trust. Collect one number you can back, such as orders shipped, and open three new ads with it.
5 of 24 ads are creator posts run from your brand page. Viewers read them as a brand ad, so the trust a creator earns gets lost. Whitelist those five and cut three variations of the best one.
0 of 24 ads carry an offer, so new buyers have no reason to act today. Add a first order offer or a spare cover bundle to line one of three new ads, so the decision happens now.
